paite: Huan Philistia mite'n kidou ding in asepaihte uh akaikhawm ua, Judah gamsung Sokoh ah akikhawm uhi. Ephes-dammim mun ah Sokoh khua leh Azekah kho kikal ah panmun akhoh uhi.
heading: Goliath In Israelte Achou

paite: Saul leh Israel mite akikhawm ua, Elah Phaizang ah panmun akhoh uhi. Philistia mite na dal ding in akiphalh uhi.
Philistia mite tang pang ah a-om ua, Israel mite bel alangkhat tang pang ah a-om ua, akikal uah phaizang a-om hi.
Philistia mite panmun a pan amihat uh, amin Goliath, Gath khomi, tong guk leh khap khat a sang ahong pawtkhia hi.
Dal lukhu akhu a, awmphaw asilh a; a-awmphaw gikdan dal shekel sangnga ahi.
Angal ah dal ngalphaw abun a, anungzang ah dal teita akuah hi.
Atei peu siamkol bang ahi a; atei lu bel sik shekel zaguk a gik ahi. Aphaw popa ama ah apai hi.
Adingh a, Israel sepaihte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a kidou dia hong kiphalh na hi ua? Kei Philistia mi, nou Saul sikha na hi kei uh maw? Mi kitel unla ka kiang ah hong paisuk hen.
Hon sual a ahon thahleh na sikha un ka om ding uh. Himahleh ke'n ka zoh a ka thahleh ka sikha un na om ding ua, ka nna uh na sem ding uh," achi hi.
Philistia mi in, "Tuni in Israel sepaihte ka chou a, mi khat hon kuansak unla ka na kisual ding uh," achi hi.
Saul leh Israel tengteng in huai Philistia mi thugente azak un, alunglel ua, lauh petmah in alau uhi.
Huchi in David tuh Judah gam a Bethlehem a Ephrath mi Jesse tapa ahi a, ama'n tapa giat anei hi. Saul hun lai in amah upa in tektak ahi khinta hi.
heading: Saul Giahphual Ah David

paite: Jesse tapa upazaw thum in kidouna ah Saul azui uhi. Atapa thum kidouna a hohte min a-upapen Eliab, azom Abinadab, athumna Shammah ahi.
David anaupangpen ahi a, a-u thumte'n Saul azui uhi.
Bethlehem ah apa belam kem in Saul kiang a pan David ava hoh hi.
Philistia mi in zingsang leh nitak teng in ava naih zel a, ni sawmli sung ava kitaklang zel hi.
Jesse in atapa David kiang ah, "Vaimim kan ephah khat leh hiai tanghou beu sawm pua inla, na unaute kiang ah agiahmun uah va hohpih pah in.
Bawngnawi dat khal sawm apawl ua sangkhat heutupa a ding in puak inla; na unaute bangchi in a-om ua va en inla, atanchin uh theihna banghiam hon pua in," achi hi.
Saul leh amau leh Israel mi tengteng Philistia mite dou ding in Elah Phaizang ah a-om uhi.

Zingkhang in David athou a, belamte chingmi khat akemsak hi. Jesse in thu apiak dungzui in apua a, akuanta hi. Kidouna mun a pawtkhe lel sepaihte kidou dia akikou zuazua laitak un amah kangtalai omna mun ava tung hi.
Israelte leh Philistia mite kidou ding in ana kikhung ua, sepaih leh sepaih ana kigalsai uhi.
David in akemmi khut ah avan akoih a, sepaihte kiang lam ah ava tai a, asanggamte chibai ava buk hi.
Amaute ahoupih laitak in ngai in, amihat uh Gath a Philistia mi amin Goliath, Philistia mite sepaih pawl lak a pan ahong paisuk a, athugen ngei mah hong gen nawn hi. Huai thu David in azata hi.
Israel mi tengteng in huai mi amuh un, ataikek ua, lauh petmah in alau uhi.

Israel mite'n, "Huai mihing hong kuankhia na mu hia? Israel mite chou dia hong kuankhia ahi. Kuapeuh amah that kumpipa'n nakpitak in sum lam in ahih hausa dia, atanu ape dia, apa inkuan Israelte lak ah azalensak ding," achi uhi.

David in akiang a dinghte kiang ah, "Hiai Philistia mi that a, Israelte minsiatna lamangmi bangchi bawl ahi dia? Hiai zeksum louh Philistia mi kua ahia ahih, Pathian hing sepaihte achou vial mahmah,” achi hi.
Mipite'n huchi in adawng ua, "Amah that peuhmah ka gen bang ua bawl ahi ding,” achi uhi.

A-u upapen Eliab in mite kiang a, athugen lai ana za hi. David tung ah Eliab aheh guih a, "Bangziak a hong suk na hia? Gamdai a belam tam lou omte kua chingsak na hia? Na kisaktheihdan leh na lungsim hoihlouhdan ka thei. Kidou en ding bang in na hong mawkmawk a," achi hi.
David in, "Bang ka hih a ahia? Aziak om hilou ahi maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n midang lam angatsan a, agen ngei mah agen hi. Mipite'n ama a mah bang in adawng nawn uhi.
David thugen azak un Saul kiang ah agensawn ua; ama'n asam hi.
David in Saul kiang ah, "Amah ziak in kuamah lungsim lunglel kei heh. Na sikha in huai Philistia mi ka va sual ding," achi hi.
Saul in David kiang ah, "Nang zaw huai Philistia mi sual ding in na kuan thei kei ding, valnou phet na hi a, amah lah avalnou tung a pan galdou siammi ahi ngal a," achi hi.
David in Saul kiang ah, "Na sikha in apa belamte achin lai in, humpinelkai hiam vompi hiam ahong kuan a, belamhon lak a pan belamnou aman hi.
Ka delhzui a, ka sual a, akam a pan ka hunkhe zel hi. Amah hong sual tum in ahong dingh a, ke'n abaksam ah ka man a, ka sual a, ka that zel hi,
Na sikha in humpinelkai leh vompi ka that tuaktuak hi. Huai zeksum louh Philistia mi amau bang in a-om sam ding hi. Pathian hing sepaihte achou vial a,” achi hi.

David in, "Humpinelkai khutbom a pan leh vompi khutbom a pan kei hon hunkhepa TOUPA'N huai Philistia mi khut a pan hon hunkhe ding," achi hi. Saul in David kiang ah, "Kuan in, na kiang ah TOUPA om hen!" achi hi.
Saul in amah galthuam David asilhsak a, dal lukhu akhusak a, awmphaw asilhsak hi.

David in agalvan tung ah anamsau akuah a, pai ding in akisa hi. Huchibang achiamteh ngei nai kei hi. David in Saul kiang ah, "Ka paipih thei kei. Hichibang ka chiamteh ngei kei," achi hi. Huchi in David in agalthuam asuahta hi.
Achiangkhun atawi a, luita a suang mum mam pilhpelh nga atel hi. Abelam chinna kawlzal ah akuah hi. Akhut a avaisuanglot tawi in, Philistia mi ava zuan naita hi.
Philistia mi ahong pai zel a, David azuan nai hulhul a; ama ah alum tawipa apai hi.
heading: David In Goliath Azou

paite: Philistia mi'n a-en vialvial a, David amuhleh asimmoh mahmah hi. Amah lah san chiuchiau, mit hah kilawmtak, valnou lel lah ahi ngal a.
Philistia mi in David kiang ah, "Ui ka hi maw chiangte toh ka kiang a na hong pai?" achi hi. Philistia mi in apathiante lou in David ahamsiatkhumta hi.
Philistia mi in David kiang ah, "Ka kiang ah hong pai in, tung a leng vasate leh gamsate na sa ka nesak ding," achi hi.
David in Philistia mi kiang ah, "Nang zaw namsau, tei leh lum tawi in na hong kuan a, himahleh kei zaw Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel Sepaihte' Pathian na kousiatpa min in ka hong kuan zaw hi.

Tuni in TOUPA'N ka khut ah nang ahon pe ding hi. Huchi in ka hon that dia, na lutang ka tan ding. Philistia sepaihte luangte tuni in tung a leng vasate leh gamsate ka nesak ding hi. Huchi in leitung a mi tengteng in Israel ah Pathian a-om chih athei ding uh.
Hiai a kikhawm tengteng in TOUPA'N namsau leh tei in ahondam kei chih athei ding uh. Kidouna lah TOUPA kidouna ahi ngal a. Ama'n ka khut uah noute ahon pe ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Philistia mi ahong kuan a, David sual dia ahon naihleh, sepaihte lam ah Philistia mi sual ding in David atai gepgep hi.
David in a-ip asawk a, suang khat alakhia a, avaisuanglot in alawn a, Philistia mi taltangtak ah adeng hi. Ataltang ah suang alut a, akhup in apuk helhul maimah hi.
Huchi in David in vaisuanglot leh suang in Philistia mi azou hi. Philistia mi adeng a, athatta hi. Himahleh David in namsau atawi kei.
Huaiziak in David atai a, Philistia mi tung ah adingh hi. Anamsau ala a, apai a pan adokkhia a, huai in athat a, alu atanta hi. Philistia mite'n amihat uh sita ahi chih atheih un ataikekta uh.
Israel mite leh Judah mite athou ua, akikou ua, Philistia mite Gath leh Ekron kulh kongkhak pha in adelh uh. Philistia mite lak a liamte Shaaraim lam tawn in Gath leh Ekron pha in apuk zengzung uhi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n Philistia mite adelh uh atawpsan ua, ahong kik nawn ua, agiahmun uh alok uhi.
David in Philistia mi lu ala a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, agalvan bel apuanin ah akoih hi.
Saul in Philistia mi sual dia David kuankhe lai amuh in sepaih heutu Abner kiang ah, "Abner, hiai valnou kua tapa ahia?" achi hi. Abner in, "Na hin bang in ka gen, toupa aw, ka thei kei," achi hi,
heading: David, Saul Kiang A Pi Ahi

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Hiai naupang kua tapa hiam dongkhia in," achi hi.
Philistia mi that David ahong pai in Abner in api a, Philistia mi lu tawi kawm in Saul kiang ah apaipih hi.
Saul in akiang ah, "Tangval, kua tapa na hia?" achi hi. David in adawng a, "Bethlehem mi na sikha Jesse tapa ka hi," achi hi.
